title: Sputum test
what: You cough up mucus from your lungs into a sterile container. The lab looks at it under a microscope and, if needed, grows a culture.
why: For a long cough with mucus, for bronchitis or pneumonia, if tuberculosis is suspected, and to choose treatment.
tell_doctor: If you already take antibiotics. This affects the result
If there was blood in your mucus
If you cannot cough up mucus

prepare.title: Time
prepare.text: Sputum is usually collected in the morning, right after you wake up. The most builds up overnight.

prepare.title: Mouth
prepare.text: Do not eat before collecting. Brush your teeth and rinse your mouth with boiled water, so extra germs do not get into the container.

prepare.title: Container
prepare.text: Get a sterile container from a pharmacy or your clinic. Do not open it early or touch the inside.

prepare.title: Several samples
prepare.text: Sometimes you are asked to collect sputum 2 or 3 days in a row. Check with your clinic.

bring: The labeled container with sputum, if you collected it at home
steps: As you breathe out, cough hard from deep in your chest
Spit the mucus into the container without touching the edges with your lips
Take it to the lab within 1 to 2 hours
feel: If mucus will not come up, warm drinks the evening before and deep breaths help
after: Saliva will not work for the test. It must be mucus from the lungs
Microscope results usually take 1 to 2 days, a culture takes several days
Talk about the result with your doctor
red_flags: Coughing up a lot of blood: call emergency services
Severe shortness of breath or chest pain: call emergency services

faq.q: How is sputum different from saliva?
faq.a: Sputum is thick and comes from the lungs with a deep cough. Saliva is thin and clear. A saliva sample is useless.

faq.q: What if I cannot cough up mucus?
faq.a: Drink more warm water the day before, and take a few deep breaths in the morning. If it still does not work, tell your doctor. There are other ways.

reminders.text: Sputum collection tomorrow morning. Get a sterile container ready, and drink more warm water this evening.
Before collecting sputum: do not eat, brush your teeth, and rinse your mouth with boiled water.
